user.title: Set up Virtual Meter
user.description:
Select the IP address and provide a serial number.

UDP Discovery Port: Use 6600 for older firmware (pre-SPC231). Use 10086 for SCharger firmware V100R023C10SPC231 and later.

Unit ID: Huawei default is 11 (0x0B). Use 1 for standard Modbus.

data.unit_id: Modbus Unit ID (11 = Huawei default, 1 = standard)

error.invalid_address: Invalid address! Please enter a valid positive number.

abort.no_registers: No registers configured yet. Use 'Add a new register mapping' first.
abort.settings_saved: Settings saved. The integration will reload to apply the new UDP port.

edit_registers.title: Edit Registers
edit_registers.description: Here you can see all configured registers as a list. To delete a register, simply clear both the entity and fixed value fields.

edit_settings.title: Settings
edit_settings.description:
Configure the UDP discovery port and Modbus unit ID.

UDP port: 6600 for older firmware (pre-SPC231), 10086 for SPC231+. Changing the port reloads the integration.

Unit ID: 11 = Huawei default (0x0B), 1 = standard Modbus. Changes apply instantly — no reload needed.
